properties.Mechanism (MOA): Inhibits Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase → ↑ intracellular Na⁺ → ↓ Na⁺/Ca²⁺ exchanger activity → ↑ intracellular & SR Ca²⁺ → positive inotropy. Also ↑ vagal tone → slows AV nodal conduction & increases AV nodal refractory period (rate control in AF).
properties.Contraindications: WPW with AF (may accelerate conduction via accessory pathway → dangerous ventricular rates); 2°/3° AV block or severe bradycardia/sick sinus without pacing (worsens block). Use caution/adjust dose in renal impairment; higher toxicity risk with hypokalemia/hypomagnesemia/hypercalcemia.
properties.Indications: (1) Chronic HFrEF: add-on to guideline-directed therapy to improve symptoms and reduce HF hospitalizations (does not clearly improve mortality). (2) AF/AFlutter: rate control, especially at rest; useful when hypotension limits β-blocker/CCB or when concomitant HFrEF.
properties.Dosing notes: Narrow therapeutic index; renal elimination—dose adjust in CKD/elderly/low body weight. Monitor serum level when needed + electrolytes (K⁺/Mg²⁺/Ca²⁺) and ECG; interactions: amiodarone, verapamil/diltiazem, macrolides, azoles can ↑ level.
properties.Adverse effects: N/V, anorexia; confusion, weakness; visual disturbance (yellow/green halos). Cardiac: bradycardia, AV block, atrial tachycardia with block, ventricular ectopy/VT/VF (risk ↑ with low K⁺, low Mg²⁺, high Ca²⁺, renal failure, drug interactions).
